text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali looks at the conclusions of an experts report on Tunisia and the world's economy. Additional economic reforms in foreign exchange and financial sectors to be discussed at a later cabinet meeting.
- Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia to visit Tunisia on December 20-22.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui back in Tunis from three-day visit to Jordan.
- U.S. firm General Electric sponsored a seminar in Washington on investments in Tunisia.
- Parliament adopted the Agriculture Ministry budget for 1997.
- President Ben Ali congratulates new U.N. Secretary-General Koffi Annan.
- Agriculture Minister Mohamed ben Rejeb told parliament that food self sufficiency was the government's priority.
